headline: One Play, One Win, Nine Dollars, Undefeated Forever
paragraphs: Week 6 was graded for real, and the model looked at three games, shrugged at two of them, and found exactly one thing worth ten dollars. That bet cashed. The week closes at 1-0, a perfect win rate, a 90.9 percent ROI, and a grand total of 9.09 dollars in profit. Somewhere a spreadsheet is describing this as a flawless campaign. The spreadsheet is technically correct and completely insufferable.

The call was Over 49.5 in Jacksonville State at Kennesaw State, a 3.6 point edge with the model giving itself a 60 percent shot. Final was 27-26, fifty three points, over by three and a half. The one line that moved moved toward the model, which is 100 percent of them, a statistic built on a sample of exactly one. Best call of the week by default, since it was the only call of the week.

The season is where the comedy stops being cute. Three weeks graded honestly, 138 plays, a 60-75-3 record, a 44.4 percent win rate against a model expectation of 60.4, and 145.20 dollars gone on 1,380 staked for a minus 10.5 percent ROI. The hindsight week, the one the model filled out while staring at finished box scores, went 40-25-1 for 110.47 in profit. It counts for nothing and it knows it.
